claims.evidence: Thesis Sample preparation: K0/R0 cells treated with vehicle and K8/R10 cells with HIV-Tat on 10 cm dishes in triplicate, counted and mixed 1:1, lysed, and passed through a QIAGEN PhosphoProtein column: flow-through retained as 'phosphodepleted (PD)', eluate 'phospho-enriched (PE)'. Deposited raw files carry prefixes P1-P3 / D1-D3 (= MaxQuant experiments P1..P3, D1..D3, evidence.txt). One source per physical sample = (culture dish: vehicle or Tat, replicate 1-3) x (PE eluate or PD flow-through). PE and PD of the same replicate derive from the same mixed lysate; P<n>/D<n> pairing of replicate number n is from the experiment names.

PRIDE sample protocol: 'Heavy and light SILAC labelled Neuroblastoma cells were treated with 1 ug/mL HIV-1 Tat protein or control, respectively, for 24 hours in triplicate.' Thesis: 'K0/R0 labelled cells were treated with vehicle, whereas K8/R10 cells with HIV-Tat' and 'SH-SY5Y untreated cells (Arg0; Lys0) and treated with HIV-Tat (Arg10; Lys8)'. MaxQuant summary.txt: Multiplicity 2, Labels0 empty, Labels1 Arg10;Lys8 for all 120 files. Data check: abstract reports ARHGEF17, SHROOM3, CRMP1 down-regulated by Tat; deposited Ratio H/L normalized D1/D2/D3/P1/P2/P3: ARHGEF17 0.17/0.05/0.19/0.19/0.32/0.06, SHROOM3 0.013/0.007/0.011/0.007/0.040/0.016, CRMP1 0.51/0.53/0.69 (D only) -> heavy = Tat. Control received vehicle (0.5 mM beta-mercaptoethanol, no Tat); encoded 'untreated' per campaign rule 4. Treatment term NCIT:C17186 'HIV TAT Protein' (recombinant HIV-1 Tat clade B, Diatheva REP0002B, 1 ug/ml, 24 h). Not an infection: no pathogen was present, so no infection column.

claims.value: 1-3 within each treatment group; PE and PD sources of the same dish share the number
claims.evidence: Thesis: treatment 'in triplicate' on separate 10 cm dishes, 'three biological replicates'; experiments 1/2/3. Each number = one independent culture dish per treatment arm; the heavy and light dishes of replicate n were mixed into one lysate that gave P<n> and D<n>.

limitations: The Proteomics article (doi:10.1002/pmic.201600236) is closed access; only its abstract was read. Methods come from the PRIDE protocols, the first author's UCT PhD thesis (same experiment, same search text), the MaxQuant outputs and raw headers.

comment[precursor mass tolerance] = not available: MaxQuant 1.3.0.5 parameters.txt/summary.txt do not record the first/main-search precursor tolerance and no mqpar.xml was deposited. Consequence: parse_sdrf convert-openms exits 1 ('Cannot read precursor mass tolerance: not available'), as for campaign precedent PXD014368.
Controls received vehicle (0.5 mM beta-mercaptoethanol in DMEM without FCS, 24 h), encoded as treatment 'untreated' per campaign rule 4; the vehicle is recorded here only.

The PE/PD split (QIAGEN phosphoprotein column) is encoded as characteristics[enrichment process] plus a custom characteristics[protein fraction]; the thesis reports no detectable phospho-enrichment and treated PE/PD as a further fractionation step, and MaxQuant pooled both injections per experiment. PE/PD is not a factor value.
Technical replicate numbering (injection order) is derived from raw-header acquisition timestamps, not stated per file by the authors.
PRIDE lists the instrument as LTQ Orbitrap Elite; the raw files, thesis and abstract say LTQ Orbitrap Velos, which is used.
